messages:
elaine: quick sync — need to lock down long-term routing + tenant isolation strategy for Dedicated/Private. multiple enterprise asks coming in, want clear launch criteria and what we call 'isolation modes'.
rajesh: two priority customer asks: 1) ability to pin tenants to specific regions/hardware, 2) guaranteed tail latency behavior during cross-region failovers. both non-negotiable for some ISO/PCI customers.
tom: tradeoff reminder: hard isolation reduces binpacking and raises cost. we should make cost/experience explicit.
min-jun: propose we split responsibilities: control-plane policy language (expresses intents) vs allocation layer (enforces isolation). keeps control plane flexible.
sabrina: example customer ask: traffic-steer by dataplane tags (hw_type: A100-vs-H100, region), AND hard isolation for PCI workloads with attestation. they want SLOs + audit trail.
elaine: suggested 12mo priorities: (1) policy primitives (latency, cost, region, tier), (2) region-aware fallback and failover, (3) tenant isolation modes (soft/hard), (4) launch checklist incl. eviction semantics. feedback?
kai: reorder: fallback patterns must be in v1 of the policy DSL. without explicit fallback ordering, incident rollback is fragile — need model_variant -> region -> capacity_tier ordering by default.
rajesh: +1. also require model version pinning in control plane so failovers don't silently switch model weights or tokenizer.
min-jun: implementation note: hard isolation implies per-tenant pools or reserved GPU slices. needs reserved capacity product changes (billing, quotas).
sabrina: that's ok for enterprise pilots; they expect higher price for hard isolation. docs and pricing must be explicit.
elaine: draft launch criteria (proposal): - policy DSL supports region + model + variant + tier + affinity - failover simulation passes (synthetic latency/partition tests) - isolation mode validated under noisy neighbor tests - SDK/docs updated + migration guide - cost impact analysis on customer workloads
tom: add observability requirement: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, route-level traces and a fallback_reason tag in spans. no cert without those.
sre-bot: incident:deploy triggered: canary of route-policy v0.3 -> eu-west-1 clusters.
rajesh: :eyes: watching the canary. keep hard-isolation hooks gated off for now.
kai: quick policy DSL sketch we discussed in design review (minimal):
```
policy "tenant-routing" {
  prioritize: [latency, cost]
  fallback: [model_variant, region, capacity_tier]
  constraints: { region: [eu-west-1, us-west-2], isolation: soft }
  affinity: { kv_hotness: region_sticky }
}
```
min-jun: add 'affinity' to keep KV cache locality. also add 'cold_start_warmup' flag for region fallback.
elaine: decision: ship policy DSL + fallback ordering in Q2 internal beta. hard isolation (tenant pools/reservations) moves to Q3 with committed pricing. pilot customers may opt into early Dedicated reserved capacity.
sabrina: action item: I'll draft customer FAQ + pilot SOW + pricing bullets. ETA: next Tue.
tom: action: infra -> prototype cross-region fallback runbook and run fault-injection sim to emulate regional latency spikes. ETA 3w.
rajesh: action: eng-ml -> implement model pinning API in control plane. small API change but blocking for safe failover. ETA 2w.
min-jun: note for Private/on-prem: constraints differ. add Private checklist: network isolation, per-tenant KMS/HSM, resource quotas, audit logs, operator runbooks.
elaine: scope negotiation: we will NOT deliver persistent multi-region KV replication in v1 due to headcount. rely on region-fallback + warmup strategies; document as known limitation.
kai: instrumentation: emit metric `routing.fallback.count` with labels (tenant, from_region, to_region, reason) and add fallback_reason tag to traces. helps postmortems + SLO alerts.
sabrina: customer ops: compile list of pilot customers + minimal SOW template. loop in growth & legal.
elaine: good session. next sync Wed 11am — agenda: finalize DSL fields + beta gating criteria. posting a short RFC for comment by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:
